items.title: Cam Skattebo: Listed atop unofficial depth chart
items.description:
Skattebo is listed as the Giants' starting running back on the team's unofficial depth chart for the preseason finale versus the Jets, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Brian Thomas: Should be fine after shoulder scare
items.description:
Coach Liam Coeh said that Thomas is "alright" after falling on his shoulder in practice, and the team will now focus on getting him ready for Week 1 against the Browns, Mia O'Brien of 1010 XL 92.5 FM Jacksonville reports.
